@graph.name: Yin-Yang Split Combat Training Shorts
@graph.description: Develop custom black-and-white split-leg MMA and training shorts with geometric artwork, an elastic waist and side slits. View customer photos and Australian buyer feedback.

mainEntity.name: Can we customize the split-leg design with our own logo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Develop your own geometric artwork, panel colors, academy or brand logo, labels and packaging. Provide authorized artwork and approve placement on the sample.

mainEntity.name: Which fabric composition and weight should we choose?

acceptedAnswer.text: Confirm composition, GSM, stretch, opacity and drying requirements using a swatch and physical sample. The reference photographs do not establish test results or exact fiber percentages.

mainEntity.name: What should we check on the side slits and waistband?

acceptedAnswer.text: Approve slit depth, hem finish, reinforcement at stress points, relaxed and stretched waist measurements, and fit during movement. Confirm the final stitch construction through sampling.

mainEntity.name: What are the MOQ and sampling requirements?

acceptedAnswer.text: MOQ and sample arrangements depend on fabric, design, colors, sizes and branding. Send your quantity, size allocation, logo or reference and target delivery date for a project-specific quotation.

mainEntity.name: Are these real product photos and what does the review cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: The front and back images are supplied customer photographs. The Australian five-star review dated June 6, 2024 describes professional service and an intention to order again. The video is a generated design presentation, not production or performance evidence.
